info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Statements-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed statements for their banking accounts, facilitating transparency and financial management. It provides access to various account statements, detailing transactions, balances, and other relevant financial information. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, financial management tools, and analysis dashboards aimed at enhancing personal finance insights. Developers can integrate this API to empower users with actionable financial data directly from their banking accounts.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve account statements, providing insight into their financial transactions over a specified period. Users can fetch these statements to review their account activity, aiding in financial planning and budgeting.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving account statements. This request should be formatted as JSON and must conform to the defined schema. Use this endpoint to access the statement data for specified accounts, ensuring that all required parameters are included.

201.description: The account statement was successfully generated.
